import itertools,json
from pathlib import Path
cases=0
for actions in itertools.product((0,1),repeat=16):
 started=closed=active=False
 old=[];new=[]
 for action in actions:
  if action==0:started=True;closed=False;active=True
  else:
   old.append(started and not closed)
   if old[-1]:closed=True
   new.append(active)
   if active:active=False
 assert old==new
 cases+=1
r={'sequences':cases,'operations_per_sequence':16,'actions':['host_applInit','host_applClose'],'close_traces_equal':True,'scope':'State-transition proof only; not concurrency or guest runtime acceptance'}
